brand.ops_manual.name: Reyes Mobile Detailing
brand.ops_manual.jobs:
Full detail: I start by pulling the mats and vacuuming the seats and carpets, then I wipe the dash, doors and cup holders. Next I wash the outside by hand with two buckets and dry it with clean towels. After that tire shine and windows inside and out. Finally I walk the car with the customer and take after photos. It takes about 3 hours.
Interior only: pull the mats, vacuum everything, shampoo stains on the seats, wipe all the hard surfaces and clean the inside of the windows. Walk it with the customer before I leave. About 90 minutes.
Wash and wax: hand wash with two buckets, dry with clean towels, then apply wax one panel at a time and buff it off. Tire shine last.
brand.ops_manual.hours: Mon to Sat, 8 am to 6 pm
